title: Miaomiao connected but no data received
symptom: Miaomiao connects to xDrip+ but no data is transferred; system status fields (Tomato Battery, Hardware, Firmware, Libre SN) are empty and no glucose values are available. Some users get a few readings then stop, or only get data when the Tomato app runs in parallel.
cause: The thread identifies multiple possible causes: the libreOOPAlgorithm interfering with the connection (deactivating it fixed for some), the Tomato app not being well connected to the sensor, or a problem with the OOP algorithm. For the original reporter, the cause was never definitively established.
fix: For some users, disabling the libreOOPAlgorithm (settings->less common setting->other misc options) resolved the issue. Others found that restarting the libreOOPAlgorithm app or resetting calibrations and restarting the Miaomiao helped. The original reporter did not find a fix and switched to Libre 2.
evidence_quote: After deactivating the libreOOPAlgorithm it went back to work! So whoever has similar problems, check for that too!
